description: Etherscan brings live public blockchain data into ChatGPT. Users can inspect wallet balances and activity, token transfers, transactions and receipts, verified contract source and ABI, event logs, blocks, gas recommendations, and supported EVM chains, then display selected results in an interactive Etherscan card. The app is read-only and cannot sign or broadcast transactions.

defaultPrompt: Show an Ethereum balance and recent activity card for this wallet.
Explain what happened in an Ethereum transaction.
Inspect a verified Ethereum smart contract and its deployment details.
